incident_details.description: The alert shows suspicious executable file activity involving TiWorker.exe running as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM, including write-to-executable, rename-to-executable, open process, and create process actions. No clear PowerShell payload, malicious network activity, or direct evidence of data theft, persistence, or impact is provided, so this is best treated as suspicious privileged activity requiring investigation.

risk_rating.rationale: SYSTEM-context TiWorker.exe activity with write/rename/create-process behavior and a 70 risk score indicates a plausible malicious or anomalous execution chain, but there is no PowerShell payload, no confirmed malware verdict, and no evidence of payload impact or service disruption.

triage.ioc_summary:
[AVAILABILITY] Unexplained changes from privileged accounts — The alert shows privileged activity under NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM with create/open/rename/write-to-executable actions, which fits unusual privileged-account activity. No evidence of crashes, CPU saturation, reboots, or malformed traffic is provided.
[INTEGRITY] Odd device/platform behaviour, Unknown binaries installed, Unknown process running, Unexplained changes from privileged accounts — The alert involves a suspicious process/file activity chain, including TiWorker.exe with write/rename to executable and process creation, which indicates odd device behavior and an unknown process/binary context. The SYSTEM context also supports unexplained privileged activity.
